protocol.label: warm-repro-20260925
protocol.comparison: Paired control vs keeper within each host; same idle, cadence, fixture and warmup count across hosts. Models and native host contexts remain different.
primaryMetrics: next user cache share and zero-read events
post-warmup input including all keeper calls
post-warmup and whole experiment CLI cost where available
paired first text and completion deltas
protocol.validity: Continuity, complete maintenance, no pause/gap, unchanged runtime/config fingerprint, monotonic idle within 5s and cadence checks. Context drift audited separately, never silently filtered.
protocol.stopping: No automatic retries or replacement pairs. Retain failures and setup usage. Hard count cap and per-request runtime timeout apply.
limitations: Two pairs per host are descriptive, not a general hit probability or provider ranking.
12-minute idle does not establish 35/70-minute retention or TTL boundaries.
Warmup attempts to absorb initial host context updates; transcript audit is still required.
Existing subscription usage is consumed; CLI estimates are not invoices or isolated quota.
